description: Real session-recovery behavior on page reload, confirmed by inspection and by a live cross-session check during Sprint 9 (a band.profile change to 'flat' made in an earlier session was still present after reopening the app in a fresh browser tab).

onReload.restoredDesign: the last saved, structurally-valid JewelryDefinition, or the default if none/invalid
onReload.validationResults: always recomputed fresh from the restored definition, never restored from storage
onReload.modelStatusAfterReload: NO_MODEL, even though the design itself was restored
onReload.viewMode: restored from its own storage key

principle: Restored design intent and restored generated geometry are never conflated — a returning user always sees their parameters exactly as left, but must regenerate to see geometry again.
